title: Chapter 316: Nine-Star Strength Attack
content:
Chapter 316: Nine-Star Strength Attack

When the Zerg army advanced to this distance, it seemed that they were ready to hold their ground. Suddenly, powerful energy fluctuations broke out in the army of the evil god camp, which was mainly engaged in defensive operations.

One after another, the energy defense shields with a huge coverage area and a strong divine breath enveloped several huge evil god camp armies. They were the elite troops of the alien race, the big demon troops of the demon race, and the direct troops of the spirit god green department of the bear goblin race.

Wu Qing learned from the intelligence provided by the goblin race that those who can play such a huge battlefield role are all precious battlefield wonders and divine objects, which are treasures that can win by surprise on the battlefield.

Many of these battlefield treasures are disposable. The better battlefield treasures can be reused, but they will also be consumed a lot after using them once.

These battlefield treasures actually use external objects to exert the power of a large energy level, but they are relatively gentle, and the scale should be just right so as not to cause the world rules to target them.

Therefore, they are all extremely rare things.

Now there are so many troops in the evil god camp that are protected by the great power of rules. It is conceivable that the three major tribes of the evil god camp have paid a great price.

The core elite troops of the three major tribes of the aliens, demons and bear goblins are protected by the great power of rules, and the attacks of the five-star soldiers of the Zerg army are no longer effective.

Led by the big demon troops of the demons that can fly at high speed, three powerful armies covered with movable rule-level energy shields rushed towards the Zerg army.

"This is cheating!"

Wu Qing was a little helpless when he saw this scene. The queen of insects who had the ability to solve this problem had better not take action. Perhaps the evil god camp did this to lure the queen of insects to take action.

Without testing this time, Wu Qing knew that only attacks with the characteristics of rule-level power could attack the evil god camp army protected by the rule-level energy shield, such as the spawning of the Zerg queen and the elimination of the Zerg scorpion, and the seven-star strength of the Zerg army, all have certain rule power attached to their attacks.

The army of the evil god camp charged very fast. The attacks of the five-star Zerg air guards and five-star Zerg Devourers in the Zerg army were helpless against the rule-level energy shield. There was not much time left, so Wu Qing could not think too much.

"Kill all the enemy's seven-star star powerhouses!"

"The Zerg Explosive Mosquito's attack is ineffective, Queen Zerg, you take action!"

Wu Qing quickly ordered the Queen Zerg.

When the six-star Zerg host noticed some abnormalities, Wu Qing consumed a lot of resources and upgraded a group of Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes mixed in the Zerg Dragon group to seven stars.

The seven-star Zerg Explosive Mosquito, with all its strength, launched a self-detonation attack, and its lethality could almost surpass the strength of two stars, which was very terrifying!

It is unknown whether the attack with a power close to nine stars can break those rule-level energy shields formed by external objects.

This is an unknown situation, so the Queen Zerg will be the last resort.

The seven-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes were already quite large, but their speed was already extremely fast. With the support of the real-time intelligence provided by the Zerg host, they appeared above the three attacking evil god camp armies like teleportation, and exploded at the same time at the best position calculated by the queen.

"Boom...!"

An indescribable explosion spread far around, and the stable space of this world during the day was instantly shaken.

At the center of the explosion, the originally invisible space suddenly appeared irregular black blocks, and soon returned to normal.

The elite troops of the three tribes of the aliens, demons and bear goblins who were charging were hit by an extremely terrible explosion!

The rule-level energy shields that protected them flashed one after another under such an attack that was no less powerful than the powerful ones, and then disappeared!

The explosion of a large number of seven-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes has generated enough lethality to rival the attack of powerful powerful people.

The explosion of the seven-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes is a loss of countless system resources. If there were other options, Wu Qing would not use such a luxurious way to attack.

But such efforts are worth it. All the extremely precious war treasures of the three major tribes in the evil god camp were destroyed in this attack.

These battlefield treasures are the foundation of the three major tribes. The loss of foundation means the loss of luck. Therefore, the system has obtained a large number of qi resources.

This can be regarded as making up for some losses.

At the same time, those seven-star strongmen of the various tribes in the evil god camp who mixed in the army of the three major tribes and wanted to rush closer to launch a surprise attack on the Zerg army were all attacked by the six-star Zerg queen and the six-star Zerg scorpion.

More than a thousand seven-star strongmen were either attacked by the six-star Zerg queen's spawning attack and were struggling in pain, or were eliminated by the six-star Zerg scorpion and disappeared.

The elite troops of the three major tribes in the evil god camp, with the powerful force star protection obtained by the self-destruction of battlefield treasures, were basically not hurt and survived the terrible disaster just now.

But without the protection of the rule-level energy shield, they could not stop the various means of the Zerg army.

Their second trump card, more than a thousand seven-star warriors, were all hit with a fatal blow before they could even make a move.

The Zerg army had the ability to kill all the seven-star warriors instantly, and they dared to strike first against the warriors of the evil god camp. These two points were somewhat beyond the expectations of the three major tribes of the evil god camp.

The loss of battlefield treasures and thousands of seven-star strongmen is a huge loss for the three major tribes of the evil god camp.

This chapter is not over yet, please click the next page to continue reading!

Before the three major tribes of the evil god camp calculated the gains and losses, the Zerg army used various means to attack the troops of the three major tribes that rushed over.

Under the parasitic control of the six-star and seven-star Zerg queens, some of the most lethal troops in the three major tribes of the evil god camp instantly turned against their companions and launched a fatal attack on their companions.

The six-star and seven-star Zerg scorpions, while killing powerful enemies with elimination, continued to create terrifying plague areas, quickly infecting the most elite troops of the three major tribes of the evil god camp.

The five-star Zerg air guards and five-star Zerg devourers, which have air superiority and extremely long range, concentrated their firepower and attacked the elite troops of the three major tribes of the evil god camp that rushed over.

The powerful coverage attack of the Zerg air guards and the terrible mucus corrosion and special spore infection attack of the Zerg devourers instantly caused a large number of casualties among the elite troops of the three major tribes of the evil god camp.

The most elite troops of the three tribes of the evil god camp all rushed up. Now that they have lost the strongest protection and all the strong men, some of them are in a dilemma and can only bite the bullet and continue to attack.

The other troops of the evil god camp, which were originally hiding in various fortifications, received the order to attack the whole army and rushed out and rushed towards the Zerg army.

The Zerg puppies and type 3 Zerg poisonous ray scorpions covered with a layer of black fog went up to fight with the evil god camp army that also received various divine arts under the protection and blessing of the black fog.

Nearly 800 six-star and seven-star Zerg scorpions continuously released plagues on the entire battlefield, quickly turning the front line of the entire battlefield into a terrible plague zone.

The plague spores in the plague zone are invisible and intangible, and the army of the evil god camp cannot perceive them at all. When they realize that something is wrong, the plague has already broken out, and their combat power quickly disappears, becoming plague infected people who can be slaughtered at will.

The Zerg Queens, who were of the same number and strength, continued to perform parasitic control, parasitizing and controlling the powerful arms of the evil god camp army in large numbers, disrupting the morale of the evil god camp army, and unexpectedly destroying the enemy in large numbers.

More than 200 six-star Zerg Mammoths were airdropped in front of the Zerg Puppies. Each six-star Zerg Mammoth led a Zerg Puppy and rushed towards the evil god camp army.

Under the precise coordination of the various arms of the Zerg army, the army of the evil god camp was powerless except for fighting with the Zerg Puppies for consumption.

The elite troops and trump cards of the evil god camp army were all played, and they were cracked one by one by the Zerg army. With the battle now at this point, they are already in a dilemma.

The alien race, who already knew the Zerg army very well, immediately decided to give up this battlefield. It was no longer necessary to fight any further.

The Demons and the Bugbears, their main sphere of influence is in this area. If they retreat, they will hardly have the opportunity to organize such a large-scale war in the future, and they are likely to be defeated by the Zerg army one by one.

After some discussion, the Demons and the Bugbears decided to continue to send reinforcements to fight a battle with the Zerg army, even if it would consume some of the Zerg army's combat power.

"We thought so before! In the end, it was a waste of troops!"

"The Zerg army, no matter how it fights, it will not weaken, which will make people despair!"

"You should think carefully and don't invest too much power!"

"My tribe will not accompany you! In the public battlefield, my tribe and the Zerg will have a big battle to fight!"

The representative of the alien race reminded the Demons and the Bugbears and left.

...

The Demons and the Bugbears took over the command of the battlefield, commanded the evil god camp army, and continued to fight the Zerg army.

The space transmission channel connecting the two major tribes and other powerful tribes in the evil god camp began to send reinforcements here. Only the space transmission channel leading to the alien tribe was directly dismantled.

The battle lasted until dark. The evil god camp lost countless soldiers, and the Zerg army also lost a lot of Zerg dogs.

The main combat arms of the Zerg army have entered the mode of rotating attacks, half attacking and half resting and recovering.

It was this situation that gave the demons and the bear goblins a little hope, but unfortunately, it was still in vain.

The reinforcements of the Zerg army were no longer coming, and the Zerg army had all advanced to the protection range of the lord of the giant city. This battle could continue at night.
